title: LLM output rendered as raw HTML with unrestricted - remote content injection and PII exfiltration channel
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Stephen Toub; component: WebApp/
rationale: Gates the emission behind IsAllowedImageUrl: only relative /product-images/... URLs (the app's own proxy, matching ProductImageUrlProvider output) are rendered; anything else — absolute, protocol-relative, data:, traversal — is downgraded to HTML-escaped inert text. Allowed branch is byte-identical to the old line 24. A CSP header is recommended defense-in-depth, out of scope for this diff.
variants_checked: MessageProcessor.cs is the only MarkupString sink in src/; sole caller Chatbot.razor:46; all other uses are static assets or provider-generated relative URLs; HybridApp has no chatbot.
bypass_considered: Absolute, protocol-relative, data:, traversal (..), self-origin authority tricks, raw-HTML injection, and plain links all fail the allowlist and render inert; residual is only same-origin /product-images/ without traversal — the endpoint's intended function.
test_note: Omitted — no WebApp test project exists (tests/ has none referencing WebApp); planned assertions documented in the patch.
review_reason: Allowlist gate at the exact sink fixes the root cause; no new surface; minimal single-file change matching the generated-regex style.
